prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Northeast US (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania)?
response_text:

_New York, NY_
Family-owned and operated, serving all five NYC boroughs and New Jersey with over 25 years of experience. They offer eco-friendly treatments for various pests, including termites, bed bugs, and rodents.

**[Viking Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Viking+Pest+Control%2C+Basking+Ridge%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Basking Ridge, NJ_
With over 45 years of experience, Viking provides licensed pest control services across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Maryland. They offer eco-friendly, science-backed treatments for a wide range of pests.

**[Majestic Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Majestic+Pest+Control%2C+Long+Island%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Long Island, NY_
Serving NYC, Long Island, and New Jersey for over 40 years, Majestic offers same-day and emergency appointments. They specialize in integrated pest management for homes, restaurants, and schools.

**[Nature Plus Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Nature+Plus+Pest+Control%2C+Brooklyn%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Brooklyn, NY_
Licensed and insured professionals providing pest and termite control services across New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Delaware. They emphasize transparent pricing and quality guarantees.

**[Helena Pest Control & Cleaning](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Helena+Pest+Control+%26+Cleaning%2C+Newark%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Newark, NJ_
Offers verified pest control and cleaning services for homes and businesses across New Jersey and New York. They provide company-assigned, trained professionals with photo proof on every job.

**[Sleep-Easy Pest Solutions](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Sleep-Easy+Pest+Solutions%2C+Lumberton+Township%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Lumberton Township, NJ_
Licensed in NJ, PA, NY, and DE, they offer premium protection plans and same-day inspections. Their services cover a broad spectrum of pests, ensuring 100% pest-free living.

**[Safety First Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Safety+First+Pest+Control%2C+Howard+Beach%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Howard Beach, NY_
Family-owned and operated for over 45 years, they provide safe, fast, and affordable pest control for homes, apartments, and businesses in New York and Northern New Jersey.

**[All National Termite & Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/All+National+Termite+%26+Pest+Control%2C+Staten+Island%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Staten Island, NY_
With over 25 years of experience, they offer safe, effective, and affordable pest control solutions across all five NYC boroughs and New Jersey.

When choosing a pest control service, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, eco-friendliness, and customer reviews to ensure they meet your specific needs.
